responsibility: Defines the Rust HIR type hierarchy and related type-bound structures. It models trait bounds, impl-trait and trait-object types, tuples, references, arrays, inferred and function-pointer types, qualified type paths, and helper payload such as maybe-named function parameters and for-lifetime lists, with cloning, visitor integration, mappings, and source locations. This file is the type-system portion of the HIR tree used by later name resolution, type checking, and code generation preparation.
